product_summary: Website (arjunanatural.com, homepage + navigation, accessed via http_get) presents the company as 'Herbal Extract Manufacturer & Exporter in India' / 'Botanical Extract Manufacturer and Supplier in India'. Declared product lines: Human Nutrition — branded standardized botanical ingredients BCM-95® (CURCUGREEN®), Rhuleave-K®, Bospure® (AKBAMAX®), Shoden®, Herbagut®, TRI-LOW®, Oxystorm®, Ellagi Rush®, Nigrin, Somin-On, Okravive, Almaragus; grouped by health indication (immunity, bone & joint, heart health, sports nutrition, gut health, mood/sleep, weight management, sexual wellness, cognitive health, women's health). Animal Nutrition — ShellMatrix, MAXMUNE, SwineMax, AquaTOC, Oxy2Grow, by species (poultry, dairy, swine, aqua). Site states ingredients are 'standardized' and 'crafted in-house'. No retail food/FMCG packaged goods, no edible oils/fats line visible in the catalogue.
role_hint: manufacturer (own branded, in-house standardized botanical extracts; no trader signs found on site — no third-party brand resale or pure distribution language)
comment: HS mapping vs declared 130239;150420: PARTIAL. The declared 130239 (vegetable mucilages/thickeners) does not cover the core business — standardized botanical/herbal extracts and oleoresins, which belong in 130219 (and 1302 more broadly). 130239 is only correct if a specific gum/mucilage product (e.g. a polysaccharide ingredient) is actually exported; the catalogue as read does not show one. 150420 (fish oils) is plausible only for a marine omega-3 ingredient (Oxystorm® is marketed as a nitrate/beet-based sports ingredient per site naming, not a fish oil) — no fish-oil product is visible in the catalogue, so 150420 is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Missing from the declaration: 210690 (branded human-nutrition blends/supplement preparations) and 230990 (animal nutrition premixes — ShellMatrix, MAXMUNE, SwineMax, AquaTOC, Oxy2Grow), i.e. an entire declared business segment (animal nutrition) has no HS line. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a B2B botanical-extract / nutraceutical-ingredient manufacturer, not an FMCG food producer; correct framing is 'фармацевтическое/нутрицевтическое сырьё, ботанические экстракты'. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection — company is retained and codes corrected to 130219 (+210690, 230990 as applicable). All product data above is from the company's own website and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available to me in this task (customs/registry/revenue research out of scope), so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted. Note: the site is JS-rendered and individual product pages returned only the navigation shell, so per-product composition (extract vs. oil vs. powder) could not be read; HS-6 assignment for individual SKUs should be confirmed against the technical data sheets. No CIN/PAN/state data collected (out of scope).
